group.title: Design-file migration
group.passage:
Engineering file migration

The design archive will move to the Atlas server on June 3. From that date, the old server will allow viewing and downloading only; all new revisions must be saved on Atlas. Existing project folder names will be preserved.

Engineers should check their active projects on Atlas by June 10 and report missing files to the migration team. Do not create replacement folders before reporting a problem, as this may lead to duplicates.

The old server will remain available until June 30. Links in internal documents may still point to the old location, so please update them when you revise a document. The migration does not change any drawing’s approval status.
group.passageZh:
工程檔案移轉

設計檔案庫將於六月三日搬到 Atlas 伺服器。從當天起，舊伺服器只能查看與下載，所有新修訂版本都必須存到 Atlas。原有專案資料夾名稱會保留。

工程師最遲應在六月十日檢查 Atlas 上進行中的專案，若有缺檔，請向移轉團隊回報。回報前不要自行建立替代資料夾，以免造成重複。

舊伺服器會保留至六月三十日。內部文件連結可能仍指向舊位置，因此修訂文件時請一併更新連結。此次移轉不會改變任何圖面的核准狀態。
